description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.
